caveats: Carrier public rates are mutable or archived; this is a bounded historical snapshot.
The FedEx index matches the observed U.S. EIA Monday price two days before the Wednesday effective date; this does not prove a billed account's exact surcharge.
UPS rate applicability may vary by service type and account-specific terms; no UPS index week is asserted in the excerpt.
Union Pacific announcement establishes the posted rate, not proof of a contractual charge to a particular shipper.
Some carrier publishing terms may constrain republication of full guides; this research retains only eleven factual numbers and links.
There is no customer consent, original invoice, payment evidence, tariff appendix or actual recovery in this research.
